question: Does the frozen exact-ecology package remove the registered three-player Infrastructure dominance and five-player path-concentration defect while preserving every profile's named play identity under unchanged physical rules?

selectionRule.balance: Select only if every three-, four-, and five-player faction, seat, profile, diversity, fallback, forced-no-op, homogeneous dominance, pairwise dominance, and adversarial bound passes.
selectionRule.measuredDefects: Five-player winning-path entropy must be at least 0.60, and the registered three-player Infrastructure Compounder plus greedy-backend cell must not appear in diagnosticDominance.
selectionRule.trustIdentity: Trust Governor must average at least one Influence selection per appearance, keep Influence below its largest Core Action, reach Trust 4 in at least 85 percent of appearances, and retain mean Mandate of at least 16.
selectionRule.capacityIdentity: Capacity Operator must average at least two Build selections per appearance, select Research plus Deploy more often than Build, and retain mean Mandate of at least 16.
selectionRule.agiIdentity: AGI Candidate must be the largest profile contributor to AGI-declaration winner credit, supply at least 30 percent of that credit overall, retain mean Mandate of at least 14, and keep Dossier as its highest Program weight.
selectionRule.infrastructureIdentity: Infrastructure Compounder must average at least two Build selections per appearance, retain mean Mandate of at least 16 at every supported count, and retain its authored Generator and two-Facility transition rules.
selectionRule.rulesBoundary: Only the four frozen strategy profile artifacts differ from the authored baseline. Starting resources, faction abilities, Core Actions, legal actions, Dossier mechanics, scoring, and physical components remain canonical.
selectionRule.promotion: A complete pass may nominate the four-profile package for explicit human approval. It cannot silently change physical rules or prove fun, negotiation quality, teachability, duration, or human counterplay.
selectionRule.failure: Any failed supported-count bound, registered defect, or identity check rejects the package. Do not adaptively retrain from this holdout. If a physical lever is implicated, preregister one separate common-seed intervention.

requiredDiagnostics: exact profile source paths and SHA-256 digests
complete executed ecology profiles and fingerprints
profile Action selections and Mandate sources
profile and faction win shares by supported player count
AGI emergence and winner override rates
